item.title: Version 1.1.0
item.description: - Keyboard control: ↑↓ move, ↩ copy (⌥↩ paste), ⌘1–9, Space for Quick Look, ⇥ filters, ⌘P pin, ⌘⌫ delete, Esc - Secrets: passwords in your Keychain, Touch ID before every copy, clipboard clears after 30 s - Look: choose the menu-bar icon (or hide it), accent colour, panel height and where the shortcut opens it - Readable on light backgrounds; dark Quick Look - Password-manager copies are never recorded; choose how many clips to keep; search matches every word - Report a Problem and What's New in Settings › About
